text:
katie: FYI - hitting a weird retry/timeouts combo in our Kotlin SDK sample when uploading large files from emulator. Works on device but flaky on emulator. :grimacing:

katie: Symptoms: Retrofit POST fails after first attempt with `java.io.IOException: unexpected end of stream` and then the SDK retry sends a second request which fails because the RequestBody is non-repeatable.

katie: Reproducer: sample-app uses `RequestBody.create(MediaType.parse(...), inputStream.readBytes())` for large streams so it's not rewindable. The SDK's default `RetryPolicy` will attempt a retry on `IOException`.

sanjay: so the retry tries to re-send a non-replayable body -> inevitable failure. Why does this surface mostly on emulator?

katie: emulator network seems to drop connections sooner during uploads, triggering `unexpected end of stream` on the client. On physical devices we get more graceful TCP behavior so it rarely happens.

jonah: classic. Two separate issues: 1) retry semantics w.r.t non-replayable bodies; 2) timeout values that are too aggressive causing mid-stream aborts. For the SDK we should ensure retries only for idempotent or replayable requests unless explicitly opted in.

marta: agreed. For onboarding docs we should call this out: "Don't rely on automatic retries for streaming uploads; provide a rewindable body or disable automatic retry for that endpoint." Add sample code for a rewindable RequestBody and for a safe-backoff policy.

katie: here's a simple rewindable wrapper we used in the sample: ```kotlin
class BufferedRequestBody(private val data: ByteArray, private val contentType: MediaType?) : RequestBody() {
  override fun contentType(): MediaType? = contentType
  override fun writeTo(sink: BufferedSink) { sink.write(data) }
  override fun contentLength(): Long = data.size.toLong()
}
```

sanjay: that's fine for small files but not for multi-GBs. For large uploads we should recommend either: multipart chunking with resumable uploads, or let the app manage retries at a higher level. Also document `Request.Builder().tag()` trick to mark requests as non-replayable so our retry layer can skip them.

jonah: also consider changing default `RetryPolicy` to be conservative: only retry for idempotent methods (GET/HEAD) or when the request has a `Replayable` tag. We can add an opt-in header `X-Redwood-Retry: true` for customers who want it.

marta: that requires an SDK change and a doc update. Open a tiny RFC? I'll create a short proposal in the SDK backlog: "Retry semantics for non-replayable bodies".

katie: additional wrinkle: emulator triggers a `SocketTimeoutException` earlier than device when upload stalls; current `callTimeout` is 60s in samples. On emulator we sometimes see a partial upload + socket close at ~22s. Lowering read/write timeouts doesn't help. Thoughts?

jonah: emulator's NAT/proxy can cause stalls. For samples/ci we should run an emulator matrix and mark streaming-upload tests as flaky. In code, set `writeTimeout` to something larger and ensure `callTimeout` permits longer uploads. But for us, it's more important to avoid unexpected retries.

sanjay: alternative: in the Retrofit layer detect non-repeatable bodies and set `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` on that call's client. We can provide a helper that clones the client with `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` and a different connection pool. Example snippet for auth-like clients: ```kotlin
val noRetryClient = client.newBuilder().retryOnConnectionFailure(false).build()
val service = retrofit.newBuilder().client(noRetryClient).build().create(UploadService::class.java)
```

katie: added that to the sample repro branch `katie/retry-nonreplayable-sample` (internal). CI will run emulator job.

ciara-bot: CI queued for branch katie/retry-nonreplayable-sample 1: emulator (api29, api31) upload tests.

marta: doc items: 1) "Emulator may close streams mid-upload" 2) "Avoid automatic SDK retry for non-replayable RequestBody" 3) "Use rewindable buffer or resumable uploads" 4) code snippets for cloning client with retry disabled. I'll draft the FAQ entry.

jonah: small SDK change proposal: add a `Request.isReplayable()` extension that checks for a tag or buffered body and use it in the retry decision. Also emit a debug log when retry skipped due to non-replayable body.

sanjay: yes and add an opt-in config `enableRetryForNonReplayableUploads` default false. Keep defaults safe.

katie: I'll follow up with PRs: samples + small SDK tweak + docs. Assigning myself. Thanks! :thumbsup:
